## The short answer

He is writing the letters **"OK"** on each glass panel. He is a **glass inspector**, and the "OK" is his **pass / approval mark** — it certifies that he has examined that particular sheet of plate glass, found it free of flaws, and is passing it as good. The man stands on the far side of a roller conveyor, wearing a dark red/maroon work shirt.
